{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values per column:")
print(trial_df.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print(f"\nDuplicate rows: {trial_df.duplicated().sum()}")

# Check the distribution of key variables
print(f"\nUnique values in 'sex': {trial_df['sex'].unique()}")
print(f"Unique values in 'arm': {trial_df['arm'].unique()}")
print(f"Unique values in 'severity': {trial_df['severity'].unique()}")

# Check the response rate by sex
table_sex_response = pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['responded'], margins=True)
print(f"\nResponse rate by sex (total, responded, rate):\n{table_sex_response}")

# Check the distribution of severity by sex
print(f"\nSeverity distribution by sex:\n{pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['severity'])}")

# Check the distribution of arm by sex
print(f"\nArm distribution by sex:\n{pd.crosstab(trial_df['sex'], trial_df['arm'])}")

# Check if severity is balanced across arms and sex
print(f"\nSeverity distribution by arm and sex:\n{pd.crosstab([trial_df['arm'], trial_df['sex']], trial_df['severity'])}")"}
